user.title: SpiderFarmer RS-485 bus
user.description: Connect one RS-485 bus (one USB-RS485 adapter). Add the integration again per additional bus — each config entry is independent, so devices with the same address on different busses (e.g. two 0x04 dimmers) coexist cleanly.

data_description.bus_name: Friendly label used for the bus hub device and to disambiguate peripherals across multiple busses. Defaults to the port basename (e.g. "ttyUSB0").

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open serial port. Check the path and permissions.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.
